name: Manuals
description: Rolling on the back wheels (or the fronts) with the other end up, from holding the balance at a wall to manualling a curb.

name: Spins & turns
description: Changing direction and spinning: two-foot turns, mohawks, three-turns, spins and turning jumps.

name: One-foot balance
description: Staying steady on one skate for longer and lower.

name: Edges & crossovers
description: Clean inside and outside edges, crossovers both ways, and the carves and slalom lines built on them.

name: Skating backwards
description: Comfortable, fast and controlled going backwards.

name: Stopping & control
description: Stopping when you mean to, at any speed, and falling well when you don't.

name: Jumps & hops
description: Getting off the ground and landing soft, from small hops to turning jumps and gaps.

name: Ramps & transitions
description: Riding banks, quarters and bowls: pumping, dropping in, stalls and airs.

name: Grinds
description: Sliding curbs, ledges, coping and rails.

name: Dance footwork
description: Rhythm, jam and slalom footwork that flows to music.

name: Speed & stamina
description: A longer, stronger stride and the fitness to keep it going.
